evidence.detail: The controller switches on EMPTY, UNCLAIMED and CLAIMED states from the retained MailAttachmentClaimStatus enum.
CLAIMED state writes the exact text '@gre@Items have been claimed!' and toggles the corresponding attachment/claim widgets.
All mutations are confined to the same 321xx mail attachment/reward widget group used by MailInboxInterface.
